claims.claim: 心肌梗死清晨发生率约为深夜的 3 倍。
claims.sourceTitle: Circadian rhythms in cardiovascular disease
claims.supportQuote: Studies found that the incidence of MI is three times higher in the morning compared to late evening.
claims.applicability: 群体时间分布特征；来源于 2025 年欧洲心脏杂志综述对既往研究的汇总，非本次新测数据。
claims.uncertainty: 综述转述既往研究，未给出原始可信区间；量级可受人群与年代影响，按 GRADE 为中等确定性（综述汇总、无单一 CI）。

claims.claim: ST 段抬高型心肌梗死清晨较下午或夜间多约 10%。
claims.sourceTitle: Circadian rhythms in cardiovascular disease
claims.supportQuote: ST segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) was ∼10% more common in the morning than in the afternoon or night.
claims.applicability: 群体时间分布特征；STEMI 亚型。
claims.uncertainty: 综述转述，未给出可信区间；效应量小（约 10%），属相对分布差异。

claims.sourceTitle: Circadian variation pattern of sudden cardiac arrest occurred in Chinese community
claims.supportQuote: Data between 2018 and 2022 from the remote ECG diagnosis system of Xinhua Hospital affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine were analysed … Among 10 210 cases of SCA, major cases (8736, 85.6%) were non-shockable and 1474 (14.4%) cases were shockable. The circadian rhythm of SCA was as follows: peak time was from 08:00 to 11:59 (30.1%), while deep valley was from 00:00 to 03:59 (7.5%).
claims.applicability: 中国社区远程心电系统 2018–2022 年数据，直接适用于中国院外/社区场景。
claims.uncertainty: 注册登记、大样本，按 GRADE 为中等确定性；为心搏骤停而非心肌梗死或卒中，人群与结局的间接性需说明。

claims.claim: 同一研究中基层医院内发生的心搏骤停未见明显昼夜差异。
claims.sourceTitle: Circadian variation pattern of sudden cardiac arrest occurred in Chinese community
claims.supportQuote: the occurrence of SCA in the primary hospitals did not appear to show an obvious circadian variation
claims.applicability: 说明清晨聚集受场所修饰，院内环境削弱该模式。
claims.uncertainty: 亚组描述性发现，未单独给出统计检验；提示分布非普遍、非必然。

claims.claim: 合并症（慢性肾脏病、糖尿病）、β 受体阻滞剂与晚期心衰治疗会削弱清晨事件聚集这一模式。
claims.sourceTitle: Circadian rhythms in cardiovascular disease
claims.supportQuote: Variations in study populations and advances in pharmacological management have highlighted factors that attenuate this pattern, including comorbidities (chronic kidney disease, diabetes mellitus 71 , 72 ), beta-blockers blunting autonomic surges, and advanced HF therapies.
claims.applicability: 说明混杂控制（尤其服药时间）对清晨聚集的影响方向：治疗可削弱晨峰。
claims.uncertainty: 综述转述；对觉醒时点与晨间活动的校正证据仍不完整，属间接证据。

claims.claim: 缺血性与出血性卒中更多发生于清晨。
claims.sourceTitle: Circadian rhythms in cardiovascular disease
claims.supportQuote: Rupture and dissection of aortic aneurysms are more likely to occur in the early morning, 99–101 as well as ischaemic and haemorrhagic stroke.
claims.applicability: 群体时间分布特征，卒中两类亚型。
claims.uncertainty: 综述转述，未给定量可信区间。

claims.claim: 清晨时段交感激活并伴循环儿茶酚胺升高。
claims.sourceTitle: Circadian rhythms in cardiovascular disease
claims.supportQuote: the early morning hours are characterized by a surge in sympathetic activity, involving increase in circulating levels of catecholamines.
claims.applicability: 机制证据：人体昼夜生理记载。
claims.uncertainty: 交感/儿茶酚胺晨峰为确立的生理现象；其与临床终点的直接联系证据层级较低（相关与机制为主）。

claims.claim: 血压晨峰及夜间血压不下降与心血管事件风险升高相关联。
claims.sourceTitle: Circadian rhythms in cardiovascular disease
claims.supportQuote: Disrupted BP rhythmicity, especially high morning surge and the absence of a nocturnal BP dip, are associated with increased risks for cardiovascular events
claims.applicability: 机制与预后证据：血压晨峰与临床终点相关。
claims.uncertainty: 关联性表述，非因果；晨峰定义在各项研究中不一，混杂校正不完整。

claims.claim: 清晨凝血与纤溶昼夜波动形成高凝、低纤溶状态，并伴血小板活性升高。
claims.sourceTitle: Circadian rhythms in cardiovascular disease
claims.supportQuote: Diurnal coagulation and fibrinolysis fluctuations, resulting in hypercoagulability and hypofibrinolytic conditions during the morning hours, together with increased platelet activity
claims.applicability: 机制证据：凝血与纤溶的昼夜变化已在人体研究中描述。
claims.uncertainty: 综述转述；与临床终点的联系为相关层面。

claims.claim: 生物性清晨血小板激活最强，且独立于行为（体位、活动、睡眠）因素，已在人体中直接检验。
claims.sourceTitle: Circadian rhythms in cardiovascular disease
claims.supportQuote: The human endogenous circadian system causes greatest platelet activation during the biological morning independent of behaviors
claims.applicability: 机制证据中层级最高者：内源性节律经行为校正后在人体中直接检验。
claims.uncertainty: 该检验对象为血小板激活，非临床事件；事件层面的独立于觉醒时点证据仍间接。

claims.claim: 基层医疗头晕的就诊患病率在各项研究间差异大（约 1% 至 15%）；最常见的病因类别为前庭/外周性（约 5% 至 42%）与心血管性（约 3% 至 56%），精神源性为约 1% 至 21%，并有相当比例（最高约 80%）无法给出明确诊断。
claims.sourceTitle: Prevalence, aetiologies and prognosis of the symptom dizziness in primary care – a systematic review
claims.supportQuote: Consultation prevalence differs between 1,0 and 15,5%. The most common aetiologies are vestibular/peripheral (5,4-42,1%) … cardiovascular disease (3,8-56,8%) … psychogenic (1,8-21,6%), no clear diagnosis (0,0-80,2%)
claims.applicability: 基层医疗场景，直接对应未确诊人群；系统评价纳入 31 项研究。
claims.uncertainty: 研究间异质性极大（I2 高），未做合并估计；按 GRADE 为低至中等确定性。源文献以欧洲小数点记法书写（如 5,4%～42,1%、3,8%～56,8%、1,8%～21,6%、80,2%），正文取其整数部分并标注约数，精确区间以源文献为准。

claims.claim: 在 65 岁以上老年头晕患者中，心血管病是最主要的贡献病因（57%），其次为外周前庭疾病（14%）与精神疾病（10%）；药物不良效应是最常见的次要病因（23%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Causes of persistent dizziness in elderly patients in primary care
claims.supportQuote: we included 417 patients aged 65 to 95 years … Cardiovas- cular disease was considered to be the most common major contributory cause of dizziness (57%), followed by peripheral vestibular disease (14%), and psychiat- ric illness (10%). An adverse drug effect was considered to be the most common minor contributory cause of dizziness (23%).
claims.applicability: 65 岁以上基层头晕患者 417 例；直接对应未确诊老年人群。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心、专家组判定病因，非标准化参考标准；按 GRADE 为低至中等确定性。

claims.claim: 老年头晕患者中近晕厥（presyncope）是最常见的头晕亚型（69%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Causes of persistent dizziness in elderly patients in primary care
claims.supportQuote: Presyncope was the most common dizziness subtype (69%).
claims.applicability: 提示老年晨起头晕中体位性低血压/近晕厥相关机制常见。
claims.uncertainty: 亚型判定基于病史，未逐一经直立性血压测量验证；单中心。

claims.claim: 基层胸痛的工作诊断以骨骼肌肉来源最多（26.1%），其后为心理性含过度换气综合征（17.0%）、心脏缺血性（14.5%）与胃肠道性（11.2%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Frequency of chest pain in primary care, diagnostic tests performed and final diagnoses
claims.supportQuote: GPs working diagnoses in most cases were of musculoskeletal origin (26.1%), followed by psychological complaints including hyperventilation syndrome (17.0%), cardiac ischaemic disease (14.5%) and gastro-intestinal origin (11.2%)
claims.applicability: 基层医疗 281 例胸痛患者，直接对应未确诊人群。
claims.uncertainty: 荷兰与比利时数据，工作诊断为全科医生初始判断；对中国人群适用性受医疗体系差异限制。

claims.claim: 基层胸痛患者中致命性病因（如心肌梗死）作为最终诊断占 8.4%。
claims.sourceTitle: Frequency of chest pain in primary care, diagnostic tests performed and final diagnoses
claims.supportQuote: Potentially life-threatening diseases as final diagnosis (such as myocardial infarction) accounted for 8.4% of all chest pain cases.
claims.applicability: 未确诊基层胸痛的致命性病因前概率；用于量化症状误判的风险权重。
claims.uncertainty: 单一登记研究，样本 281 例；前概率随年龄与危险因素显著变动，8.4% 为人群平均。

claims.claim: 急性心肌梗死总缺血时间的 60–80% 发生在住院之前，由患者寻求帮助的决策延迟决定。
claims.sourceTitle: Surviving to Acute Myocardial Infarction: The Role of Psychological Factors and Alexithymia in Delayed Time to Searching Care: A Systematic Review
claims.supportQuote: the largest proportion (60–80%) of the total ischemic time (from AMI symptoms onset to the recanalization of the culprit coronary artery) occurs before hospitalization
claims.applicability: 说明患者决策延迟是缺血时间的主要组成部分，支撑自行处置风险。
claims.uncertainty: 系统评价转述既往文献；区间宽（60–80%），受医疗体系与人群影响。

claims.claim: 急性冠脉综合征患者院前延迟每增加 30 分钟，1 年死亡率升高 7.5%。
claims.sourceTitle: A systematic review of educational interventions aiming to reduce prehospital delay in patients with acute coronary syndrome
claims.supportQuote: 1-year mortality increase by 7.5% for every additional 30 min of prehospital delay (PHD)
claims.applicability: 量化就医延迟的损伤，直接支撑「任何自救用药不得推迟呼叫急救」的实践要点。
claims.uncertainty: 系统评价引用既往研究；为关联性剂量-反应，非随机证据。

claims.claim: 认为自己能控制症状并采取自行服药、休息、等待症状消失等应对方式，与更长的院前延迟相关。
claims.sourceTitle: Surviving to Acute Myocardial Infarction: The Role of Psychological Factors and Alexithymia in Delayed Time to Searching Care: A Systematic Review
claims.supportQuote: longer PHD was associated with the presumed ability to control symptoms and consequential dysfunctional coping strategies, such as taking medications, resting, trying to relax, praying or wishing symptoms would go away.
claims.applicability: 自行服药作为应对方式与延迟相关，直接对应无诊断家庭常备急救药的风险链条。
claims.uncertainty: 系统评价汇总观察性研究，为相关而非因果；未单独区分处方药与 OTC 自救。

claims.claim: 未把症状归因于心脏来源的患者，延迟到院的风险约为正确归因者的 6.9 倍。
claims.sourceTitle: Surviving to Acute Myocardial Infarction: The Role of Psychological Factors and Alexithymia in Delayed Time to Searching Care: A Systematic Review
claims.supportQuote: the risk of delaying hospital presentation in patients who did not attribute their symptoms to a cardiac origin was approximately 6.9 times higher than in those who did
claims.applicability: 症状误归因的延迟风险；支撑「晨起胸闷不应自行判断为非心脏来源」的实践要点。
claims.uncertainty: 转述单项病例对照研究（165 例）；6.9 倍为未校正风险，需谨慎外推。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸的随机对照 meta 分析纳入 41 项试验、6276 例冠心病患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis.
claims.applicability: 研究对象为已确诊冠心病患者，非未确诊人群。
claims.uncertainty: 全部 41 项试验在中国进行，发表偏倚与中文数据库覆盖需注意。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸改善冠心病患者心电图结果（RR 1.32，95% CI 1.26～1.38）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Administration of suxiao jiuxin pill significantly improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001).
claims.applicability: 结局为心电图（替代终点），人群为已确诊冠心病。
claims.uncertainty: 主要结局为替代终点而非临床事件；异质性 I2 62.3%。

claims.claim: 纳入的速效救心丸试验因缺乏双盲设计而 Jadad 评分普遍偏低。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The majority of the included studies received low Jadad scores due to the lack of a double-blind design
claims.applicability: 偏倚风险评估依据，直接支撑确定性降级。
claims.uncertainty: Jadad 评分为 meta 分析作者评定，非独立复核。

claims.claim: 该 meta 分析未分析心血管死亡或药物相关并发症。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: In this study, we did not analyze cardiovascular death or drug-related complications.
claims.applicability: 说明该药证据缺乏临床硬终点与安全性定量数据。
claims.uncertainty: 作者自述局限性，属明确的证据缺口。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸最常见的不良反应为轻微头痛、头晕与面部潮红，多自行缓解。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The most common symptoms were mild headache, dizziness, and facial flushing. Most of these symptoms resolved spontaneously.
claims.applicability: 不良反应记载；注意该药本身可引起头晕，可能加重晨起头晕的自我误判。
claims.uncertainty: 14 项试验报告，不良反应率与对照无显著差异，但无分母发生率与因果评定。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸在中国广泛用于心绞痛治疗，其离体人体动脉研究显示可诱导血管舒张并抑制收缩。
claims.sourceTitle: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill Induces Potent Relaxation and Inhibition on Contraction in Human Artery and the Mechanism
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill, a compound Chinese traditional medicine with main components of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol, is widely used for antiangina treatment in China but its pharmacological effect on human blood vessels is unknown.
claims.applicability: 药理学机制证据（人体离体动脉），提示方向性作用；非临床结局证据。
claims.uncertainty: 离体血管研究，不外推至临床疗效或安全性边界。

claims.claim: 胸部出现突发且不缓解的疼痛或不适时应立即呼叫急救（中国为 120）。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: Call 999 if: - you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away
claims.applicability: 官方公共卫生分诊指引；急救号码按中国（120）本地化，命题保持忠实。
claims.uncertainty: 英国指南，急救号码经本地化；命题本身为通用急救原则。

claims.claim: 多数胸痛并非心脏问题所致。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: In most cases, chest pain is not caused by a heart problem.
claims.applicability: 支持「未确诊者晨起胸闷多数非心脏来源」的表述。
claims.uncertainty: 定性表述，无定量比例；与基层胸痛病因数据一致。

claims.claim: 不应自行诊断胸痛病因，有疑虑应就医。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: Do not self-diagnose – see a GP if you're worried.
claims.applicability: 直接对应「不应自行判断病因并擅自备药/用药」的实践要点。
claims.uncertainty: 官方分诊指引，属强推荐但非定量证据。

claims.claim: 未确诊人群的晨起头晕、胸闷病因高度异质：基层胸痛致命性病因占 8.4%，老年头晕以心血管（57%）、前庭（14%）、精神（10%）为前三位，药物效应为最常见次要病因（23%）。
claims.applicability: 综合两类症状的两项基层研究，描述未确诊人群主诉的病因分散性；用于反驳「晨起头晕胸闷即心肌缺血」的单一归因。
claims.uncertainty: 两项研究来自欧洲（荷兰/比利时），对中国人群适用性受医疗体系与人群构成影响；头晕与胸痛属不同症状，合并表述时已分别标注各自来源。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Frequency of chest pain in primary care, diagnostic tests performed and final diagnoses
supportingSources.supportQuote: Potentially life-threatening diseases as final diagnosis (such as myocardial infarction) accounted for 8.4% of all chest pain cases.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Causes of persistent dizziness in elderly patients in primary care
supportingSources.supportQuote: Cardiovas- cular disease was considered to be the most common major contributory cause of dizziness (57%), followed by peripheral vestibular disease (14%), and psychiat- ric illness (10%). An adverse drug effect was considered to be the most common minor contributory cause of dizziness (23%).

claims.claim: 荷兰与比利时的基层胸痛登记研究共纳入 281 例患者，其最终诊断以骨骼肌肉来源为主（33.1%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Frequency of chest pain in primary care, diagnostic tests performed and final diagnoses
claims.supportQuote: In 281 (1.26%), chest pain was a reason for consulting the GP … Musculoskeletal pain was the most frequent working (26.1%) and final diagnoses (33.1%).
claims.applicability: 基层医疗未确诊胸痛人群的最终诊断分布；用于量化骨骼肌肉来源占多数的具体比例。
claims.uncertainty: 单一登记研究；荷兰与比利时数据，对中国人群适用性受医疗体系差异限制。

claims.claim: 由清晨事件聚集的群体时间分布推断「晨起头晕胸闷即心肌缺血信号」并据此主张未确诊者备药，其推理链条在症状病因归属与个体获益-风险两层断裂，不能成立。
claims.method: 将问题拆为三层并逐一核验：第一层时间分布——CLM-001/CLM-003 显示清晨事件聚集成立；第二层症状病因归属——CLM-015 显示基层胸痛致命性病因仅占 8.4%，即该主诉对心肌缺血的指向性弱，且未检索到该组合主诉的诊断效能数据；第三层个体获益-风险——CLM-020 显示速效救心丸证据限于已确诊冠心病人群，未确诊场景无获益证据。由第一层成立推至个体结论，需第二、第三层各自成立；两层均不满足，故推断不成立。
claims.assumptions: 三层推理各自独立且逐层递进；群体时间分布成立不蕴含个体症状即缺血；任一层的缺口不能由其余层填补。
claims.sensitivity: 若未确诊人群前概率高于基层胸痛的 8.4%（如高龄、合并多重危险因素者），致命病因比例上升，风险侧权重增大，结论方向不变；若未来出现该主诉诊断效能与速效救心丸在未确诊人群的对照研究，第三层证据状态可改变，本推断相应更新。
claims.applicability: 本文的中心推理边界：群体时间分布证据与个体用药决策证据须分别陈述。
claims.uncertainty: 属逻辑与证据综合的推断而非测量结果，不进入临床实践要点。
